subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings hide or neutralize external/non-file transcript paths, or intentionally expose existence metadata for existing outside-root paths and directories?
rationale: The remaining Missing-label fix crosses the fs-safe workspace boundary; automation should not choose whether outside-root or symlink-target metadata is product-safe to expose.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden, neutral, or filtered, and the UI avoids false alarming labels without raw filesystem stat fallbacks.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The Gateway may report existence, size, and timestamps for transcript-mentioned external paths, but only with explicit tests and documented security semantics.

options.title: Split Layout First
options.body: Land only any still-needed rail layout proof/fix while leaving external path metadata semantics for a separate decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden, neutral, or filtered, and the UI avoids false alarming labels without raw filesystem stat fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-file preview and fs-safe workspace helper work makes this the strongest available owner for the boundary decision.
